title: Write a review for this AI game — Cinematic trailer made with Veo 3
author: MusicalMadnes
selftext:
None of this gameplay is real. All video was generated using Veo 3. Happy to share any prompts/process. 

What would your review say?

comments.author: Default_Admin
comments.body: Game looks uncoordinated. No clear story or direction. Looks like a fake phone game ad with birds snakes and a rock climber.

comments.author: deebs299
comments.body: I can’t wait for this to be linked with consistent maps and controllable characters

replies.author: MusicalMadnes
replies.body: What if the map had permanence within each session, but regenerated every time, with user input and decisions shaping how it forms?

replies.author: Von_Dooms
replies.body: So, if I found something I thought was awesome, I could never visit it again?

replies.author: MusicalMadnes
replies.body:
What if you could save a regeneration seed for your favorite locations? That way, the world remains dynamic, but favorite spots can be kept? 

The main philosophy behind regenerated landscapes is 

1. Allows user to feel more of an open world experience

2. Illusion of bigger map with less assets needed

3. Saves tons of storage and compute to make the game more technically feasible

comments.author: ChrisTamalpaisGames
comments.body: Review of what? This is a video

comments.author: onkus
comments.body: This is not a cinematic trailer for a game.
